## Favorite Graph

This is my favorite graph I have created because it is ugly

```{r echo=FALSE}
penguin = read.csv("penguins.csv")
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = penguin, aes(x = X, y = bill_depth_mm, color = "Bill Depth")) +
  geom_line(data = penguin, aes(x = X, y = flipper_length_mm, color = "Flipper Length")) +
  labs(y = "mm", color = "Measurement") +
  coord_polar()
```
